verdict.rationale: Zero is open source and explicitly advertises self-hosting ('Run your own email app with ease'), with setup steps for the environment and a quick-start for the database and dev servers. However, the mail pipeline still depends on external providers: Google OAuth is required for Gmail integration, the founder says it works on top of Gmail, and the roadmap still lists 'Self-hosting capabilities' as an item. Missing for 10: a self-owned mail transport/pipeline independent of Gmail/Outlook, documentation of production self-host deployment (including the Durable Object/R2 storage path), and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
